user_wiring_clarification: Before installation, the wired gamepad was replaced with its 2.4 GHz USB receiver.
post_install_monitor_interpretation: No USB kernel messages, but zero IRQ progress; URB submission growth does not prove successful transfers.
fd_probe_interpretation: File descriptors opened successfully; no functional input qualification.
subsequent_recovery: One explicit USB host rebind, same boot and display owner; not a permanent recovery policy.
subsequent_direct_evidence: Three USBDEVFS_SUBMITURB calls for the freshly enumerated 045e:028e receiver returned ENOSPC after successful interface claims.
scope_boundary: The ENOSPC evidence describes the post-recovery schedule; it does not prove all earlier USB stalls had this cause.
